source_plan.actor_readback: native-raw-actors.jsonl with ego and all circulating actors, measured after each world tick
source_plan.frame_join: video_frames.jsonl and trace.jsonl must share original Native frame/time identity
source_plan.video_requirement: four synchronized original source streams, 600 frames each

term_to_measurement.st.roundabout: map readback, ring and entry lane topology, plus overview pixels
term_to_measurement.drv.approaching: ego actor road/lane pose before yield line
term_to_measurement.drv.entering_intersection: first original ego body crossing of ring entry boundary
term_to_measurement.rel.occupies: circulating actor bodies within ring at entry
term_to_measurement.drv.yields_to: ordering of circulating actor conflict crossing and ego entry, with no forced reaction claim
term_to_measurement.rel.surface_gap: frame bracket to previous and next circulating actor conflict-neighborhood occupancy
term_to_measurement.drv.time_to_conflict: projected actor travel time to source-defined common conflict neighborhood
term_to_measurement.drv.hard_deceleration: circulating actor velocity differences with tick identity, separately from legal judgment
term_to_measurement.drv.stopped: ego original speed and body position over contiguous pre-entry wait frames
term_to_measurement.drv.arrival_order: source-frame ordering of circulating actor and ego conflict-boundary crossings

numeric_policy: Six-metre conflict neighborhood in diagnostic is an engineering test proxy only; sufficient statutory gap is not numerically defined here.
